comments.value:
It would be nice to have this control enabled client-side. I understand the security concern of people having cameras out, but making it an OPTION for the client to toggle camera visibility for -all- participants would help a great deal - Especially for those of us who Roleplay
In particular it is a bother when we have participants who are in invisible avatars like extras and NPCs positioning for scenes. Their cameras floating will give them away and ruin any suspense or surprise 
Having it be a client-side option would allow users to toggle it off if they are comfortable with not seeing the cameras, but still have it available for most - As I understand this is a security/privacy concern on the VRchat side.

comments.mergedPostDetails: For those trying to get cinematic shots in VRChat for roleplay or other reasons it would be seriously helpful to have a button on player end that can fully hide the floating camera lenses of others so they are not a distraction. I understand why you would want the lenses visible but an option to locally turn them off on player end would be so useful for filming/streaming/taking photos.

A toggle in the settings to hide other players' camera pills would be very useful. I understand the safety reasons why the pill exists, but if I have to choose and toggle other people's cameras off myself, and it defaults to on, then there should be no issue.

In large streamed lobbies, especially Roleplays, you might have 10-20 camera pills hovering around in front of your face, clipping into your face, and obstructing the game. It becomes incredibly frustrating.
Sometimes other people's cameras are just in the way. I'd like to be able to hide them, but not even hiding UI gets rid of the lenses themselves.

comments.value:
This became even more relevant after the update, now there's turbo annoying icons over peoples camera, why would anyone even care that the cameramans earmuffs are on, now I just have more things taking up screenspace I didn't want lmao. 

I want to retain usernames/statuses but hide everything else.

To add onto this, it would be great if we could have a separate option to hide your own handheld camera, while leaving nameplates on...

I usually want to take a picture where everyone's names are still shown above them, but the camera object becomes a nuisance that you have to try and hide behind you, which can be impossible depending on how you're trying to take a picture.

A simple toggle to have the game hide its active object visibility during the frame the photo is taken would be wonderful (and perhaps an option to turn OFF "backface" rendering of it, so you can still easily frame your shot, but not have it block the view of you or scenery.

details:
Under "UI Elements" I think there should be a button to toggle other user's cameras from appearing on my end. 
Many people use cameras while streaming and often times the camera, and little nameplate that goes with it, end up blocking out my screen and forcing me to use the "Disable Nameplates" option. 
However that only removes the little camera nameplate and leaves me guessing who I'm talking with.
